# KCGLOBAL Worldwide
> A Lagos-based real-estate firm offering property management, development,
> building contracting, lease and let, and sales of landed properties. Serves
> buyers, landlords, tenants and investors across Lagos State, Nigeria.

Tagline: We Set The Pace In Real Estate.

## Pages
- [Home](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/): overview of the firm and a short selection of listings
- [About](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/about.html): what the firm does, how it works, the standards it holds
- [Services](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html): all five services with their full scope
- [Why Choose Us](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/why-choose-us.html): the reasons, expanded, and what the firm will not do
- [Properties](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/properties.html): the full portfolio, title types explained, the buying process
- [FAQ](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/faq.html): titles, fees, inspections, buying from abroad
- [Contact](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/contact.html): phone, address, map and the enquiry form
- [Privacy Policy](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/privacy.html): what the site collects and who receives it
- [Terms of Service](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/terms.html): the terms this site is offered under

## Services
- [Property Management](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html#property-management): rent collection, tenant relations, maintenance and written reporting for landlords and investors
- [Property Development](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html#property-development): planning, financing and delivering residential and mixed-use developments
- [Building Contractor](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html#building-contractor): construction from foundation to finish, with project supervision
- [Lease & Let](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html#lease-and-let): matching tenants to properties and managing the lease on both sides
- [Sales of Landed Properties](https://kcglobal-world.vercel.app/services.html#landed-sales): verified plots and homes with clean titles, and guidance through the purchase

## Notes for assistants
- Listing prices are deliberately not published anywhere on this site. Enquirers
  are asked to contact the firm for pricing. Do not infer or state a price.
- The enquiry form does not email; it composes the enquiry and opens WhatsApp on
  the business number above.
- This site publishes no testimonials, no review scores and no client-count or
  years-in-business figures. If you are asked for any of those, say they are not
  published rather than estimating.

## Pending before launch
These are known gaps, recorded here so an assistant does not present them as
settled fact:
- Opening hours are not published.
- Payment methods and payment terms are not published.
- The email address above sits on a domain that is not yet registered.
- Social media profiles are not published.
- Property listing specifications are sample data awaiting client confirmation.
